note: Generation caps per case, and per model overrides under models[<--model-id>][<case_id>]. hf runs fall back to the case defaults below; api runs have no fallback and refuse a (model, case) with no entry. Since 2026-11-07 every api model has the same cap, 32768, on every case: a single test budget rather than a per-model calibration, so a new model needs no calibration run. A reply cut off by the cap is scored by its case's rule (wrong in th_knowledge, excluded as no_answer in the other cases). The longest finished replies measured before the change were 24129 (th_knowledge), 16969 (over_refusal) and 11430 (en_text); th_text on the Qwen models had not been measured above 8192. The gateway bills a request to its cap even when the client closes the stream early. protocols[<--model-id>] is the sampling an api run uses when no sampling flag is given (vendor thinking-mode settings; top_k is sent in extra_body); an api run for a model with no entry is refused, and hf runs are greedy.
